_comment: Material database. Order defines the material index used by the terrain shader (max 24). value = credits per unit, yield = inventory units per cubic metre excavated, hardness = minimum tool power needed.

materials.name: Soft Soil
materials.desc: Crumbly, friendly dirt. Everybody starts somewhere.

materials.name: Dense Clay
materials.desc: Sticky terracotta-coloured clay. Needs a proper spade.

materials.name: Bluestone
materials.desc: Cool blue-grey stone. Shovels bounce off it.

materials.name: Dusk Granite
materials.desc: Dense violet granite from the deep. Drill territory.

materials.name: Heartshell
materials.desc: The warm, humming shell around a planet's heart.

materials.name: Pip Quartz
materials.desc: Pink sugar-crystal that sprouts on Pipseed's hills. Shatters into tidy shards.

materials.name: Copper Nuggets
materials.desc: Shiny orange nuggets hiding just under the grass.

materials.name: Rustberry Iron
materials.desc: Deep red iron ore that clumps like berries.

materials.name: Sungold
materials.desc: Buttery yellow gold. It practically glows.

materials.name: Dream Amethyst
materials.desc: Softly glowing purple crystal. Hums when you hold it.

materials.name: Starglass
materials.desc: A shard of something that fell from very far away.

materials.name: Glimmer Dust
materials.desc: Powdery lilac dust that sparkles underfoot.

materials.name: Glass Crust
materials.desc: Brittle teal glass-rock. Rings like a bell.

materials.name: Geode Rock
materials.desc: Midnight-blue rock stuffed with hidden pockets.

materials.name: Moonsilver
materials.desc: Pale, cold metal that never tarnishes.

materials.name: Blush Quartz
materials.desc: Warm pink quartz. Popular with robots.

materials.name: Void Opal
materials.desc: A gem that seems deeper than it is wide.
